vars.report: a jump pressed just after running off a ledge does nothing, though the game is meant to forgive a press up to a tenth of a second late

vars.subject: Movement class (scripts/movement.gd: running, the jump, coyote time and the jump buffer)
vars.rules: a jump pressed up to a tenth of a second after running off a ledge still jumps and one pressed later does not, a press up to 0.2 seconds before landing jumps on landing and an earlier one is forgotten, one press is one jump (no second jump in mid-air), letting go of jump early gives a lower hop than holding it, and a held jump peaks at the same height at 30, 60 and 120 ticks a second

mutants.name: the jump buffer forgets at once
letting go early does not cut the jump
gravity per tick, not per second

vars.feature: checkpoints: Rules (scripts/rules.gd) gets reach_checkpoint(at: Vector3) -> bool, which keeps at and returns true when it is further along the level (a larger x) than the last checkpoint, and false otherwise, and respawn_point() -> Vector3, the furthest checkpoint reached, or the start given to start_level() before any; start_level() forgets the last level's checkpoint
